findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: rh_token_verdict · Private data: rh_token_rugcheck, rh_pools_new, sol_bursts_live, sol_wallet_leaders, rh_token_precall, rh_token_verdict, sol_token_verdict, scanner_grade, sol_calls_outcomes, sol_calls_live, desk_trades, sol_wallet_copy_stats, stream_pass · Public sink: rh_token_rugcheck, sol_bursts_live, sol_wallet_leaders, rh_token_precall, rh_token_verdict, scanner_grade, sol_calls_outcomes, sol_grads_history · Destructive: rh_token_precall.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: rh_token_verdict · Private data: rh_token_rugcheck, rh_pools_new, sol_bursts_live, sol_wallet_leaders, rh_token_precall, rh_token_verdict, sol_token_verdict, scanner_grade, sol_calls_outcomes, sol_calls_live, desk_trades, sol_wallet_copy_stats, stream_pass · Public sink: rh_token_rugcheck, sol_bursts_live, sol_wallet_leaders, rh_token_precall, rh_token_verdict, scanner_grade, sol_calls_outcomes, sol_grads_history · Destructive: rh_token_precall

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
